_comment: Adversarial-review dispositions for the SIM domain, read by tools/migration_loop.py's review_gate(). A function the manifest flags review_required (writes a roster region OR size>p90 OR is root) may not be promoted to `verified` without an entry here. Shape: "<function name>": {"disposition": "reviewed"|"exempt", "session": "<YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM>", "by": "<reimpl-verify workflow / agent>", "note": "<evidence, or why no shadow/review applies>"}. A `reviewed` entry MUST name the `session` that ran the review: the driver cross-checks that that session's captured agents (session_reports/loop/<session>/agents.json) actually include an adversarial-review spawn -- a bare `reviewed` with no spawn is rejected. An `exempt` entry needs no agent (it is an explicit human-auditable decision). Keys beginning with _ are comments. Rows verified before the gate landed (2026-08-26) carry explicit grandfather exempt entries (backfilled same day). Two layers now read this file: migration_loop.py gates the TRANSITION to verified per session and cross-checks agent backing; migration_session.py --end fails while ANY review_required+verified row lacks a disposition, so a skip is caught in-session.

llm_strat_bldg_state_to_unit.note: RE-DISPOSED 2026-09-07, the SECOND row to break the 2026-08-26 grandfather exemption (see llm_strat_unit_state_squad_merge for the first). The elevation stamp read cfg offset 0x19b (`elevation`) where the asm reads 0x19f (`elevation_2`): 0x00471688 is `MOV EAX,[EAX+0xe4a237]` with EAX=proto*0x23f and cfg_units' base 0xe4a098, so 0xe4a237-0xe4a098 = 0x19f. Two adjacent, identically-typed, UNCOMMENTED int32 fields -- and the .cpp, the header banner's offset table AND the selftest were all written from the same wrong premise, so all three agreed with each other and none with the binary. The tree already knew the right mapping elsewhere (sim_map_unit_add.cpp does `u.elevation = proto.elevation_2`, and sim_unit_state_takeoff.h carries a CORRECTION banner establishing ceiling=0x19b/floor=0x19f). Fixed in all three; the selftest now seeds a THIRD distinct value into the neighbour field and asserts the result is not it, and that assertion is mutation-checked (reverting the .cpp fails it). Found by `--ui-abc spcamp_solo`: ship diverged from the recording at sim step 27,123 in the `units` region and rolling back this one [state_handler_skip] slot cleared all 878 mismatches. Kept `exempt` rather than `reviewed` because no loop session with a captured review spawn backs it.

llm_strat_unit_state_squad_merge.note: RE-DISPOSED 2026-09-07: the 2026-08-26 grandfather exemption on this row was WRONG, and this is the first row proved so. Two real translation defects survived it -- a family-scan off-by-one (`expected` compared before its increment, 0x0047eb05/0x0047eb1b) that made family_count 1 and bailed EVERY merge, and two missing byte copies in loop 2 (cur_x/cur_y = start_x/start_y, 0x0047eecb/0x0047ef03). The offline oracle could not see either: its cfg fixture had been fitted to the buggy predicate (an impossible 1,1,2 soldier_count run) and it never read cur_x/cur_y at all. Both fixed, both now pinned by simtest T8/T11, and both confirmed by an independent adversarial re-derivation from the asm + Ghidra decompile. The evidence that FOUND them is the SPCAMP A/B/C scenario (`--ui-abc spcamp_solo`), a recorded human campaign session in which the player merges soldiers into a squad; kept `exempt` rather than `reviewed` because no loop session with a captured review spawn backs it -- the review was an ad-hoc conductor fan-out.
